pages.text: The $(item)Engine Gearbox$() is a compact gearbox sized to sit next to an engine. It connects on its $(item)front$() and on $(item)both sides$(), so it turns an engine's output line through a right angle and lets you branch it to two machines.

It is placed facing the way you look, like most Create blocks.$(br2)$(l)Tips for small engines$()$(li)Start with a type I engine on creosote or furnace gas with simple cylinders: both fuels come early, from the coke oven and the blast furnace.

$(li)Move to diesel or kerosene for heavy machines: their torque factor is 1.4.$(li)Length adds torque, the signal and the speed factors add RPM. Plan the row for the stress you need, then pick fuel and upgrades for the speed.
$(li)Lubrication oil and cooling fluid together roughly halve fuel use.$(li)A piping upgrade plus a big tank makes an engine that runs for hours unattended, as long as the exhaust is pumped away.
